name: Inue Shinbee
source:
Warrior who holds the orb of 'benevolence'.
From the time he was born he's never opened his left hand and he hides it in his pocket.
His face is cute but he's a cheeky brat, the protagonist cant trust him.
He's [url=/c42264]Fusahachi's[/url] son.
